motivation: CB1 learned one binary context-dependent relationship, but never tested four relations in one shared public timeline or how contradiction-induced revision affects cold retention.

known_structure: R7 low 2 bits gate is explicitly GIVEN as a public routing feature, not learned or source-private. CB1 universal 38 binary features and four-bin truth-table grammar already contain every candidate law. No invention of gates, operators or causal law families is claimed.

method.candidate: four CB1 ConditionalTemporalBinder instances, one per public mode; after sealing, 4×75-byte source-verified checkpoints. Old reference retained only via pre-revision immutable cold checkpoint.

negative_controls: No-scope single final law used in all modes

method.cold: Canonical SHA-256 envelope snapshot and exact restoration, byte identity, corruption/private fields rejected; independent unchanged-mode byte receipts before/after revision
